learn.title: Shortcuts for similarity
learn.body: Like congruence, similarity has shortcuts. You do not need to check every side and angle. Two of the three tests need only angles or only side ratios.

learn.title: AA: angle, angle
learn.body: If two angles of one triangle equal two angles of another, the triangles are similar. The third angles must also match, since each triangle has an angle sum of $180^\circ$.

learn.title: SSS and SAS for similarity
learn.body: SSS: all three pairs of sides are in the same ratio. SAS: two pairs of sides are in the same ratio and the angles between them are equal. These look like the congruence tests, but with ratios instead of equal lengths.

learn.title: Test for similarity
steps: Sides $3,4,6$ and $6,8,12$: ratios $2,2,2$, so SSS, similar.
Sides 4 and 6 with a $50^\circ$ angle between, and sides 6 and 9 with $50^\circ$ between: $\frac46=\frac69$, so SAS, similar.

learn.body: With AA you never need a side length. Two matching angles are enough.

questions.prompt: Two triangles each have angles $40^\circ$ and $75^\circ$. What can you conclude?
questions.explanation: Two equal angles prove similarity by AA, but sizes may differ.

questions.prompt: A triangle has angles $50^\circ$ and $60^\circ$. Any triangle similar to it has a third angle of how many degrees?
questions.explanation: The third angle is $180-50-60=70$, and a similar triangle has the same three angles.

questions.prompt: Sides $3,4,6$ and $6,8,12$. Are the triangles similar?
choices: Only if the angles are known

questions.prompt: Sides $2,3,4$ and $4,6,9$. Are the triangles similar?
choices: No, the ratios are not all equal
questions.explanation: The ratios are $2,2,2.25$. One ratio is different, so SSS fails.

questions.prompt: AA similarity needs only two pairs of equal \_\_.
questions.explanation: Equal angles are enough, because the third angle then matches too.

questions.prompt: Which test needs the angle BETWEEN two proportional sides?
questions.explanation: SAS uses two proportional sides and the equal angle between them.

questions.prompt: Match each test to what you compare.
questions.explanation: AA, SSS and SAS are the three similarity tests. Three equal angles is just AA.
